text.description_html:
Fusion TR-S8, Shaker Hand Towel Ring

The Shaker Towel Ring has a rustic look that is very popular with today's home decorators. Every detail about this hand towel ring makes it perfect for bathrooms with ann earthy feel. Choose from either medium bronze or oil rubbed bronze finishes. The Shaker Trim Towel Ring is mounted to the wall near the bathroom sink. It is easy to install and comes packaged with the mounting screws.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-S8 Shaker Towel Bar, Fusion RH-S8 Shaker Robe Hook, and Fusion PH-S8 Shaker Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Sonoma Series Shaker Rose Towel Ring:

  • Mount Width: 2-1/2"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/4"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
